_doc: Every hand-set number of Kael's stage-2 parts (tools/blender/gf_hero/s2_kael_parts.py). Metres, Blender axes (Z up, he faces -Y, +X = his left). theta = the angle round the body axis: 0 = front, 90 = his left, 180 = back. Measured on the approved front (2.163 mm/px, crown y 27, sole y 998, centre x 752; z = (998 - y_px) x 0.002163) and on the recentred stage-1 blockout; the brief's section 3/4 callouts give the materials.

body._doc: the under-layer body: the trousers get 1 cm of cloth volume on the thighs and knees; the soles of the feet are lifted 2.2 cm so the boot sole (z 0) has room under them. Zones: skin above neck_skin_z (head, neck) and on the right hand's fingers past glove_finger_abs_x; the fingerless glove on the right hand; the ghost flesh on the LEFT arm past ghost_abs_x (below the bicep strap, decisions[ghost_arm_side]); black cloth (shirt, trousers) elsewhere.

hair._doc: Brax's shell method: the body's own head quads above the hairline pushed out to the blockout's hair (ray hits, clipped to [min_off, max_off], smoothed), closed with a rim; plus chunky locks swept up and back (the concept's dark swept hair; the light streak over the ghost side is paint). phi = the angle round the head from the face (0) to the back (180), symmetric. The chin beard: a short goatee shell under the mouth (the concept), stubble is paint.

clumps._doc: locks swept back along the scalp: length from the front hairline (x0.7 .. x1.3 front to back), lift = how far they rise off the scalp

fringe._doc: three locks falling forward over the brow on his right (image left) and one over the ghost side

hair._doc_dark_lum: 1.0: every blockout hit over the scalp counts as hair (the TRELLIS hair texture is lit and not reliably dark)

scarf._doc: the black scarf wrapped round the neck inside the collar (concept), with a short drape on the chest

belts._doc: upper belt with the oval bronze buckle and the ghost gem (concept y 350-375: z 1.35-1.40); the lower slung belt (z 1.26-1.31, lower on his right where the holster hangs) with a rectangular buckle on his right front

bandolier._doc: cartridge strap from his right shoulder across the chest to his left hip (concept: cartridges from (x -0.06, z 1.62) to (x 0.10, z 1.40)), under the coat except in its open front

holster._doc: the long holster on his right thigh (concept x 630-660 px, y 440-610 px: z 0.84-1.21), empty (weapons are separate models), flat against the outer thigh, hanging from the lower belt; two thigh straps
holster._doc_theta: the holster sits on the front-outer face of the right thigh (theta 316: his right front), where the concept shows it in the coat's opening

pouch._doc: the pouch on his left hip (concept x 835-865 px, y 370-410 px), on the lower belt

arms._doc: right forearm: the leather bracer with two straps and the glove cuff; left (ghost) arm: the bicep strap just below the rolled sleeve and a wrist strap (concept)

loin._doc: the maroon torn cloth hanging from the lower belt between the legs to 27 % of his height (concept), draping over the most forward surface above it and hanging straight below

boots._doc: tall buckled boots: a shaft round the calf (the body's section + off), a lofted foot shell round the body's foot, a pointed flared knee cuff (concept y 700-780 px: z 0.47-0.64, pointed over the knee), three strap bands with buckles (the concept's overlapping strap plates)

coat._doc: The long duster (brief pillar 1). YOKE: the body's own quads from the waist cut up to the neck and out to the sleeve ends, pushed out along the normals (off) and given thickness (the lining inside, a worn rim on every edge), open at the front in a V (open_half_width by z) and round the neck; the right sleeve ends at the elbow (concept 0.61), the LEFT sleeve is rolled up above the ghost arm (0.37). SKIRT: from z_top (tucked inside the yoke's wall) to the torn hem: an A-line whose half-axes grow with the drop below the waist (sides, front, back: the concept's flare 0.84 / 1.01 m at 51 / 41 % of his height), never closer to the body, belts, holster, pouch, loin cloth and boots than clear; open at the front (theta_open), a centre back vent from vent_z, torn hem points (long / short tears, slits between the last rows). COLLAR: the high standing collar with two flared points framing the head (concept z 1.88). LAPELS: wide folded-back lapels along the opening. CUFFS: rolled cuffs at both sleeve ends.

skirt._doc_axes: half-axis = v0 + v1 x (z_top - z): sides a, front bf, back bb

wisps._doc: the ghost-flame tatters (brief swatch 12): chunky emissive cloth tongues on the hem, two at each front corner and one at the back (off-centre), each for a 3-bone x_wisp chain; root = z above the local hem where the tongue starts on the coat, length = how far it falls past the hem, curl = how far its tip lifts outward
